question: Should OpenClaw own Twilio RCS as a bundled channel, or should this implementation ship as an external ClawHub plugin using the existing channel-plugin seams?
rationale: The implementation is feasible through existing plugin APIs, while repository direction keeps optional and commercial service integrations external unless maintainers explicitly accept their long-term product, security, documentation, and compatibility ownership.

options.title: Ship through ClawHub
options.body: Keep the channel externally maintained and publish it as a native RCS channel plugin with compatibility metadata, setup documentation, secret/config declarations, and live smoke proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled ownership
options.body: Accept the channel into core after the persistence and lockfile defects are repaired, dependency changes are authorized, upgrade behavior is proven, and real Twilio RCS evidence is supplied.

recommendation.title: Ship through ClawHub
recommendation.body: Keep the channel externally maintained and publish it as a native RCS channel plugin with compatibility metadata, setup documentation, secret/config declarations, and live smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest available ownership signal is the introduction and merger of the bundled Twilio SMS channel that this proposal extends.
